SELECT 
  strftime('%Y-%m', orders.order_date) as month,
  SUM(order_items.qty * order_items.unit_price) as sales
FROM orders
JOIN order_items ON orders.id = order_items.order_id
WHERE orders.status IN ('paid', 'shipped')
  AND strftime('%Y-%m', orders.order_date) IN ('2026-09', '2026-10')
GROUP BY strftime('%Y-%m', orders.order_date)
ORDER BY month

SELECT 
  SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y-%m', orders.order_date) = '2026-09' AND orders.status IN ('paid', 'shipped') THEN order_items.qty * order_items.unit_price ELSE 0 END) -
  SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y-%m', orders.order_date) = '2026-10' AND orders.status IN ('paid', 'shipped') THEN order_items.qty * order_items.unit_price ELSE 0 END) as sales_change
FROM orders
JOIN order_items ON orders.id = order_items.order_id

SELECT 
    (SELECT SUM(oi.qty * oi.unit_price) 
     FROM order_items oi
     JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.id
     JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.id
     WHERE o.status IN ('paid', 'shipped')
     AND p.category_id IN (1, 2, 3, 4)) AS digital_sales,
    (SELECT SUM(oi.qty * oi.unit_price) 
     FROM order_items oi
     JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.id
     WHERE o.status IN ('paid', 'shipped')) AS total_sales;
SELECT (209330.25 * 100.0 / 229474.7) AS percentage;

SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN o.status IN ('paid', 'shipped') THEN oi.qty * oi.unit_price ELSE 0 END) AS total_sales,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN o.status IN ('paid', 'shipped') THEN o.id END) AS valid_orders
FROM orders o
JOIN order_items oi ON o.id = oi.order_id;
SELECT 229474.7 / 102 AS avg_order_amount;

SELECT 
    c.name AS category_name,
    SUM(oi.qty * (oi.unit_price - p.cost)) AS gross_profit
FROM categories c
JOIN products p ON c.id = p.category_id
JOIN order_items oi ON p.id = oi.product_id
JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.id
WHERE o.status IN ('paid', 'shipped')
GROUP BY c.name
ORDER BY gross_profit DESC
LIMIT 1
